text:
lina: Quick check — AcmeCloud marketplace + NitroGPU partner go-live next week. We need a short partner support path: shared private channel, SEV levels, who gets paged, and a war-room template. Proposing #partner-acme-nitro-support (private) + oncall rotation. Any objections?

sam: +1 to private channel. For SEV0/1 we want immediate phone bridge + all-hands ping. Proposed escalation chain: support -> eng-sre -> runtime oncall -> eng-lead. Also suggest a pinned doc with triage checklist.

dave: I'll be the primary support POC until handoff. I'll own 1st-line triage. Can we add a vendor contact entry for Nitro hw eng? They want their HW SE on the bridge for SEV1.

hui: Partner asked that announcements be staggered; they want a partner rep on the channel for 72h post-launch. I'll add their rep: @nitro-amy. Add SLA expectations in the channel topic?

sam: Agreed. Channel topic = 'SEV process | SLOs | contacts'. For pings: use @channel for SEV1 only. For SEV2 use direct pings. Example incident template to paste in channel: ```SEV: 1
Summary: ...
Impact: ...
Contacts: support@redwood, sam (eng-sre), dave (support), nitro-amy
Next steps: ...```

lina: Nice. Two open q's: 1) Should we require partner-rep on the bridge for SEV2? 2) Who owns postmortem? I vote joint postmortem within 72h.

dave: Partner on bridge for SEV2 only if they opt in. For postmortem, support + partner ops + eng-sre co-author. I'll own doc and invite Nitro.

oncall-bot: warroom created: https://warrooms.redwood/1834001 (channel: #partner-acme-nitro-support) — join to register.

hui: I'll coordinate announcement timing and add partner rep to the channel once legal signs off on the joint comms plan.

lina: Action items: (1) sam create pinned triage checklist + incident template (2) dave create contact card for Nitro (3) hui add partner rep & confirm 72h coverage (4) sam + dave schedule joint postmortem template. I'll set a quick 15-min pre-launch sync 30m before go-live. :calendar:

sam: ack

dave: ack

hui: ack
